Class RecoveringTransactionalProducer<K,V>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.configuration.kafka.RecoveringTransactionalProducer<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - The key type
V - The value type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, Producer<K,V>
@Internal public final class RecoveringTransactionalProducer<K,V> extends Object implements Producer<K,V>
Wraps a transactional Kafka producer and recreates it when Kafka expires the transactional id.
